title: Waystar to Bring Revenue Cycle Intelligence to Google Cloud’s Gemini for healthcare
summary: Waystar (Nasdaq: WAY), a provider of leading healthcare payment software, today released The State of the Mid-Revenue Cycle report. The new research found unanimous interest among healthcare finance leaders in a single AI-powered platform connecting the mid-cycle to the final claim, yet 86% lack true integration between those systems, relying instead on manual data transfers or disconnected solutions across the revenue cycle.

# Waystar to Bring Revenue Cycle Intelligence to Google Cloud’s Gemini for healthcare


Published on **November 24, 2026**


*Integration will enable providers to access Waystar’s AI-powered analytics and key revenue cycle capabilities directly within Gemini for healthcare*


*Waystar extends AltitudeAI™ innovations through open-standard, interoperable workflows and MCP, building on multi-year collaboration with Google Cloud*


LEHI, Utah and LOUISVILLE, Ky., Nov. 24, 2026 — Waystar (Nasdaq: WAY), a provider of leading healthcare payment software, today announced it will expand access for providers to AI-powered revenue cycle solutions and intelligence through its integration with Google Cloud’s new Gemini for healthcare solution.


Waystar and Google Cloud’s[multi-year partnership](https://www.waystar.com/news/waystar-deploys-generative-ai-to-simplify-healthcare-payments-in-collaboration-with-google-cloud/) has produced agentic and generative AI innovations applied to real-world healthcare revenue cycle challenges. This latest collaboration will expand access to Waystar AltitudeAI™ innovations, enabling providers to analyze revenue cycle performance and initiate insurance eligibility verification through natural-language interactions within Gemini for healthcare. By connecting Google Cloud’s capabilities with Waystar’s extensive healthcare payments network and intelligence, providers will be empowered to move more seamlessly from information to insight to action, without navigating disconnected systems.


The integration will bring greater access to advanced analytics and revenue cycle insights through Waystar’s recently launched conversational AI, which has helped early adopters reduce time spent analyzing complex claims and payer payments datasets by up to 75%. Waystar’s Model Context Protocol (MCP) connector also enables new opportunities to utilize natural-language engagement with Gemini, including simplifying the crucial but often manual task of eligibility verification.


“Advancing a more autonomous revenue cycle requires more than AI alone — it requires trusted intelligence, deep connectivity, and the ability to take action,” said Matt Hawkins, Waystar Chief Executive Officer. “Connecting with Gemini for healthcare magnifies our value proposition as the revenue cycle’s system of action — bringing together financial, clinical, and administrative intelligence to power smarter automation and more connected experiences for providers. By extending the reach of Waystar’s AI innovations, we’re helping providers reduce administrative burden, get paid faster and more accurately, and ultimately focus more resources on patient care.”


“By bringing Waystar’s AI-powered revenue cycle capabilities into Gemini for healthcare, we’re helping providers simplify some of the most complex operational and financial tasks in care delivery,” said Aashima Gupta, managing director, Healthcare, Google Cloud. “Together, we are unifying data and workflows in a secure, governed workspace that drives better outcomes across the healthcare ecosystem.”


This next partnership phase reinforces Waystar’s strategy to make purpose-built AI innovations more accessible across the healthcare ecosystem. Built on open standards and backed by rigorous security and compliance practices, these integrations extend Waystar’s commitment to connecting fragmented workflows, simplifying healthcare payments for providers, and accelerating the path toward a more autonomous revenue cycle.


**About Waystar**


Waystar’s mission-critical software is purpose-built to simplify healthcare payments so providers can prioritize patient care and optimize their financial performance. Waystar serves approximately 30,000 clients, representing approximately 1.5 million distinct providers, including 16 of 20 institutions on the U.S. News Best Hospitals list. Waystar’s enterprise-grade platform annually processes over 8.5 billion healthcare payment transactions, including over $3.0 trillion in annual gross claims and spanning approximately 60% of U.S. patients. Waystar strives to transform healthcare payments so providers can focus on what matters most: their patients and communities. Discover the way forward at[waystar.com](https://www.waystar.com/) .
